# Generated GR00T N1.7 processor layout controls

All processor/statistics files used by test_consumer_context.py are generated inside temporary test directories. No real checkpoint, run or sample is represented. The uppercase enum layout, defaults, G1 key order and normalization routing are derived from NVIDIA Isaac-GR00T revision 944fe70c4fd54e3fcb80a7d7258a328f9c061176. These native sources carry NVIDIA copyright and SPDX Apache-2.0 headers. No native Python was copied into this fixture or executed by these tests. The selected fixed G1 dimensions are the qualified 43-state/35-action profile; differing dimensions remain unsupported rather than inferred model widths.

The existing repository Apache license applies to source-derived constants. Native source identity pointers are recorded in consumer_context.NATIVE_SOURCES and the proposal protocol. Native loader/serializer parity and actual sample effects remain separate gates.
